name: Hungry Crafter
description: Villagers and craftspeople get hungry: the moment it starts they say so in the game's own speech bubble; while hungry they greet with complaints (a new one at each greeting), say farewell with a plea, open their dialogue menu with a plea of their own, and their talk page gets a topic "Here, have some bread." that feeds them (a villager without a talk page gets one); once fed they thank you and are as before. /hunger starve|feed [all] for the nearest NPC (or all). The server decides; players whose game runs Kiln (0.2.0-dev.32 for the menu parts) see them, vanilla players keep the game's lines. Sample for docs/kiln/services/npc-speech.md (Kiln.Npcs), after Marshall's (Ryrin's) requests.
